author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.19 shipped: HVAC night holds follow the house sleep state, not the 21:00 clock
summary: HVAC night holds follow the house sleep state, not the 21:00 clock
why: The long HVAC night holds (15-30 min) were sized for sleepers but switched on at the hardcoded 21:00 home_night boundary while the house was still active; a kitchen pass-through at 21:00 kept zone 3 on home for 20+ min. Operator: follow the house sleep state. D0 probe found 1 exposed bedroom gap in 7.7 days, below the revive-C bar.
implications: Shipped HVAC-NIGHT-TAIL-STARTS-TOO-EARLY-1 at v5.103.19; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.19.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: A bedroom sleeper lost between 21:00 and house sleep onset, or operator wants per-room night start (revive C)

refs.release_notes: HVAC uses the long night hold for a room only while the house is in its sleep or waking state (your Sleep Start Hour, 22:00 live) instead of from the hardcoded 21:00 night boundary. From 21:00 until sleep, rooms use their normal day hold. Fans and overnight occupancy trust are unchanged. See docs/readmes/README_v5.103.19.md.
